metadata.description: Log Analytics workspace name that Microsoft Sentinel is enabled on
Resource name of the analytics rule 'MDE - PowerShell EncodedCommand With Long Payload'

properties.displayName: MDE - PowerShell EncodedCommand With Long Payload
properties.description:
Detects powershell.exe / pwsh.exe invocations with -EncodedCommand (or short
aliases -enc, -e, -ec) and a Base64 payload longer than 250 chars. Decodes
short payloads inline. Long encoded command lines are almost always malicious
in non-admin environments.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-(?:enc(?:odedcommand)?|e|ec)\s+[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{250,}"
| extend EncodedBlob = extract(@"(?i)\s-(?:enc(?:odedcommand)?|e|ec)\s+([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend DecodedAttempt = iff(strlen(EncodedBlob) < 4000,
                              base64_decode_tostring(EncodedBlob),
                              "<too long, decode offline>")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          EncodedBlob, DecodedAttempt, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{FileName}} on {{DeviceName}} ran with a long Base64 -EncodedCommand payload. Decode it from the alert's EncodedBlob or DecodedAttempt column before dispositioning.
